summary: community.general deprecated rhsm_repository state present/absent (use enabled/disabled, removal 10.0.0), and stackdriver and webfaction modules whose APIs no longer exist (removal 9.0.0).
questions: rhsm_repository state present is deprecated, what should I use?
Are the webfaction modules being removed?

answer_card.title: rhsm_repository states and dead API modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- `rhsm_repository`: `state: present`/`absent` deprecated (removal 10.0.0); use **`state: enabled`** / **`disabled`**.
- Removed in 9.0.0 (APIs gone): `stackdriver`, `webfaction_app`, `webfaction_db`, `webfaction_domain`, `webfaction_mailbox`, `webfaction_site`.
